      "snippet": "You can’t get true “hands-off” automation by making two ChatGPT tabs drive each other inside the UI (that’s brittle and runs into platform rules). The reliable way is to run a tiny external orchestrator that:

spins up two agents (“A” and “B”) via API,

relays their messages through Supabase (so it’s observable + stoppable),

prints the dialogue live so you can sit back and watch, and

logs EvidenceChain + Introspection automatically.
